title: Kangana Ranaut Slams Hrithik Roshan Over Comments on Saba Azad
summary: Kangana Ranaut made a snide remark to Hrithik Roshan, saying 'You are committed, don't tease a woman' after he commented on Saba Azad. The incident occurred at an event in Mumbai. Kangana Ranaut claimed that Hrithik Roshan was 'embarrassing his partner'. The comments were made during a press conference.
summary_points: Kangana Ranaut made a snide remark to Hrithik Roshan
The remark was in response to Hrithik's comments on Saba Azad
The incident occurred at an event in Mumbai
Kangana Ranaut claimed that Hrithik was 'embarrassing his partner'
